faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Find answers to the most common questions about AI deployment and Diteka services.
faq.q1: What is Diteka and who is it for?
faq.a1: Diteka helps businesses and individuals start using artificial intelligence simply and without stress. We serve small and medium businesses, teams, and individuals who want to work more effectively with AI.
faq.a2: No. Our methodology is designed for people without programming experience. We work simply, without technical jargon — we explain everything in plain language.
faq.a3: We start with an audit — we learn your needs and processes. Then we prepare a plan and guide you step by step to the result. The whole process runs at your own pace.
faq.a4: The price depends on the project scope and selected services. Contact us and we'll discuss the best option for your needs and budget.
faq.q5: Can I get help if I'm already using AI tools?
faq.a5: Yes! We provide ongoing support and training. Whether you're just starting out or already using AI — we can help you go further and be more effective.
faq.a6: Easily! Write to us or fill in the contact form. Within 24 hours we'll get in touch and discuss your needs.
